sloka: शक्यो धारयितुम् कामो भवेत् अभ्यागतो मया ।यदि भूयो वसन्तो माम् न हन्यात् पुष्पित द्रुमः ॥४-१-६९॥
transliteration: śakyo dhārayitum kāmo bhavet abhyāgato mayā ।yadi bhūyo vasanto mām na hanyāt puṣpita drumaḥ ॥4-1-69॥

translations.english: 'Whatever was endearing to me earlier in the company of Sita, has turned out to be disenchanting without her.
